prompts.seal-release-v4: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game VFX asset replacing a chunky block-pixel effect. Image 1 is STYLE / COLOR / MATERIAL reference: match the fine classic MapleStory sprite-detail and soft icy blue sheen of this sealed character, not giant square pixels. Draw one frame of a sparse outward burst of 8 small translucent ice shards and 5 tiny blue-white sparkle motes, arranged at different radial distances around a large EMPTY center. Small shards are irregular angular fragments with delicate thin cyan outlines, soft pale-blue gradients and white highlights, faded blue glows, realistic sprite proportions. This will animate over the reference ice when it breaks. Fine smooth sprite detail comparable to MapleStory native spell effects and Pink Bean NPC, slightly pixel-compatible thin outlines but NO coarse 8-bit block clusters, no bright blue-black jagged outline. Preserve empty transparent center so original character can show through. No complete ice cocoon, no character, no rings, no text, no scenery. Full burst inside canvas with 10% transparent margin. True transparent RGBA.
prompts.leion-cage-v4: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D MapleStory game background-object sprite on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA. Image 1 is the ACTUAL map screenshot: match its fine native MapleStory sprite art, cool gray stone colosseum, weathered gray iron, muted purple-gray lighting and pale warm torch highlights. Image 2 is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: Leion, the small chibi boy with spiky golden-yellow hair and purple/gold warrior clothing. Create ONE small makeshift captive animal-pen-style iron cage with Leion trapped inside, intended to sit in the rear middle of this arena. A squat rectangular 3D cage viewed from straight side-scroller front with only a little top and right side visible, thin weathered gray iron bars, muted bronze rivets, small locked front gate and lock, low gray stone plinth that blends with this map's masonry. Keep Leion face readable between bars, native chibi proportions and detailed sprite rendering, golden hair and purple suit exactly recognizable. His sword rests at his side, captive subdued expression. Cage width approx 1.25 times its height, Leion occupies 60 percent cage height, bars spaced generously. Subtle grounded contact shadow limited under plinth. Soft fine pixel-compatible outlines and tiny shaded details, same resolution feel as native monster sprite, NOT giant coarse square pixels, NOT smooth modern vector/cartoon illustration, NOT UI frame or glowing ice. The asset alone, not the full arena. Full cage and plinth inside canvas with 8 percent transparent margins. No arrow, no labels, no text, no surrounding scenery, no decorative gold UI border. Lighting should match the map, no bright spotlight.
prompts.leion-open-cage-v6: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent MapleStory-style colosseum cage sprite, open state. Input image 1 is the CLOSED cage reference that must match exactly; image 2 is the existing OPEN sprite to correct. Keep image 2's exact 1536x1024 canvas, cage body, top frame, perspective, stone base, scale, location, rusty gray iron palette and the small LEFT gate swung outward LEFT. RIGHT three quarters of front cage bars must remain closed and unchanged. Empty cage: no character. Crucial correction: remove the solid dark wall/backplate inside the cage. It is an open see-through BARRED animal cage, NOT a solid-backed cabinet. Behind the front bars, show only thin rear iron bars and side bars, with genuine transparent alpha gaps between them so the actual game colosseum background shows through. Make gate opening also transparent; no painted dark rectangle, no background fill, no checkerboard. Keep existing opaque iron bars and stone plinth. No extra ornaments, no text. The open/closed sprites must register without shifting or changing outline.
